title_sq: Tek Liqeni I Thate, Shitet Ambient Biznesi !!
description_sq: Ne Rrugen Hamdi Garunja, prane Pasta Madre shitet ambient komercial, ne katin zero dhe katin e pare te nje pallati te ri, i pajisur me ashensor. Ambienti ka siperfaqe totale ne te dyja katet prej 396 m2. Kati zero ka siperfaqe prej 251 m2 dhe eshte i organizuar ne nje ambjent openspace, dy dhoma, dy tualete dhe nje depo. Kati i pare eshte me siperfaqe prej 145 m2 dhe eshte i organizuar ne nje ambjent openspace, nje zyre dhe nje tualet.. Te dy Ambientet kane lidhje me njeri-tjetrin me shkalle, por kane dhe hyrje me vete seicila. Te dyja ambjentet shiten edhe bashke, por edhe te ndare, seicili me vete, pasi dhe certifikatat e pronesise i kane me vete. Fakti qe ndodhet ne zone periferike dhe anes rruges te jep mundesi ta shrfytezosh si zyre Arkitekturore, Studio te ndryshme, Linje Prodhimi, etj.
title_en: Near Lake I Thate, Business premises for sale!!
description_en: On Hamdi Garunja Street, near Pasta Madre, commercial premises are for sale, on the ground floor and the first floor of a new building, equipped with an elevator. The environment has a total area of ​​396 m2 on both floors. The ground floor has an area of ​​251 m2 and is organized in an open space environment, two rooms, two toilets and a warehouse. The first floor has an area of ​​145 m2 and is organized in an open space, an office and a toilet.. Both premises are connected to each other by stairs, but each has its own entrance. Both premises are sold together, but also separately, each separately, as they also have the ownership certificates with them. The fact that it is located in a suburban area and on the side of the road gives you the opportunity to use it as an architectural office, various studios, production lines, etc.
